title: Casting record
description: The per-dispatch attestation row (P15 + §7.3 standing telemetry): what was requested, what actually served the turn, and what it cost. requested_casting vs served_model is the substitution detector — a mismatch is a routing incident (P15), re-run and check whether any verdict was issued against substituted output.

served_model.description: Where exposed; the literal UNKNOWN otherwise

served_model_mismatch.description: True/false when served_model is known — whether it differs from requested_casting.model (a P15 routing incident when true). COMPUTED, not schema-enforced (ruling 4, WO-8): the Verifier's artifact validation recomputes served_model vs requested_casting.model whenever served_model is not UNKNOWN, and refuses a record that contradicts or omits a computable mismatch. null ONLY when served_model is the literal 'UNKNOWN' — the mismatch question could not even be asked (WO-14b leg 5); never null otherwise, never false to mean 'unknown'.

bucket.description: Which allowance bucket the call drew from (e.g. AU-S, AU-O, AU-F, OU)

draw_estimate.description: AU or OU per the bucket

review_cross_family.description: dispatcher-set; a mandatory-class change closed with false is an incident, not a tripwire (§3.4)

review_policy.description: The policy the DISPATCHER computed at routing time (router.js reviewPolicy(), carried on the envelope order) — never the executor's opinion. Required so the ledger can answer 'which band was this closed under', which the 2026-09-02 oracle could not (FINDINGS 1, UNCERTAIN 'Per-ticket risk/policy').

close_mode.description: How the ticket actually closed: 'verifier-only' = the §3 Verifier-only exemption (dispatcher-recorded review_policy none + Verifier PASS + deterministic_only_closure + a diff inside the 2-file/20-line ceiling), 'reviewed' = the ordinary cross-family reviewer close #2, 'recon' = the read-only Investigator close. An enum, never a free string: a typo must not read as a new exemption.

close_mode_reason.description: Set when an exemption was ATTEMPTED and refused — names the condition that failed, so a fall-through to review is auditable rather than invisible.

diff_files.description: Files touched by the pinned base..head range, as measured by git diff --numstat at close. Recorded on the verifier-only path so the exemption ceiling is re-checkable from the ledger alone.

diff_lines.description: Changed lines (additions + deletions) across the pinned base..head range.

escape.description: Set later, when a defect the review missed surfaces
